fine: Correct AtliQ entity: Inc for a USA counterparty
Governing law matches entity: laws of the State of Illinois (Inc → US law)
Payment terms of 30 days from invoice receipt are acceptable and align with the playbook.
Deliverables ownership transfer upon full payment and the perpetual license for background Vendor Tools match the standard.
The mutual indemnity for negligence and standard IP infringement protection for deliverables are acceptable.

No complex or unreasonable acceptance criteria are included, with a standard warranty re-performance period for non-conforming deliverables.

hits.text:
15.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore.

15.2 The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith discussions between senior executives for thirty (30) days.

15.3 Any dispute not so resolved shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre ("**SIAC**") under the SIAC Rules in force at the time. The seat of arbitration shall be Singapore. The tribunal shall consist of one (1) arbitrator. The language of arbitration shall be English.
hits.differs: Governed by Illinois law instead of Singapore law; both mandate 30-day negotiation and SIAC arbitration in Singapore.

hits.text:
21.1 This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it shall be governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre.

21.2 The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation between senior executives for thirty (30) days.

21.3 Failing resolution, the courts of the Dubai International Financial Centre shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
hits.differs: Governed by Illinois law with SIAC arbitration in Singapore instead of DIFC governing law and courts.

hits.text:
17.1 This Agreement and any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by the law of England and Wales.

17.2 Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules. The number of arbitrators shall be one. The seat of arbitration shall be London. The language of the arbitration shall be English.
hits.differs: Governed by Illinois law with SIAC arbitration in Singapore instead of English law with LCIA arbitration in London.
